_doc: 2026-11-12 World Map v2 region visuals, generated by tools/asset-pipeline/make_region_env.py (free, deterministic): Không Đảo. Backdrop composition per art bible §6.4 (far band 20 %, props only in the horizon band and the 80 px margins, bottom 36 % stepped), slabs = the forest 9-slice / stamps recoloured colour-for-colour to this region's ramp (no pixel moved), support kit = the forest wall / pillar / arch recoloured by luminance rank. A PixelLab painterly pass can replace bg_*_far_*.png one for one (same names) without touching this file.

flagstone_meta._doc: 2026-11-12 arena surface integration: 16 procedural 64x64 flagstones of this region's own construction (tools/asset-pipeline/make_region_flagstones.py, deterministic, 0 gen; anatomy measured on the forest PixelLab sheet). Nine-cropped per cell like the forest's; plain tiles weigh most.

slab._doc_perimeter: 2026-11-12: the ground reaching onto the cells along the board's outer edges (SlabPainter.paint_perimeter_cover, seeded; <= depth px, only on open sides).

platform._doc_face_tile: 2026-11-12 arena integration: the front face is a 12 px course cut from this region's own foundation strip, so lip and wall are one material (as the forest's lip is cut from its wall).
platform._doc_rim: 2026-11-12: the region's edge rim over the front faces (SlabPainter.paint_rim_strip), rising rim_rise px into the deck margin, never over a cell.

support._doc_foot: 2026-11-12: the ground-contact strip at the foundation's foot (SupportLayer._draw_foot_strip): how this region's ground meets the wall.

areas._doc: Floor progression inside the region: edge (first third of the map columns), inner, sanctum (the warden). Same rule shape as the forest (ArtAssets.area_for).
